name: mikuos
description: mikuOS 0.3, a Unix-like system built on the Thistle kernel.

scripts.build: bun run stage:thistle && bun run build:thistle:staged && bun run teto:build:staged
scripts.build:thistle: bun run stage:thistle && bun run build:thistle:staged
scripts.teto:build: bun run stage:thistle && bun run teto:build:staged
scripts.teto:validate: bun install --cwd deps/teto --no-save --ignore-scripts && bun run --cwd deps/teto build
scripts.test: bun run build && bun scripts/ci/stage-thistle-native.mts --check && bun src/test/all.ts
scripts.test:guest-toolchain: bun run build && THISTLE_FUEL=0 bun src/test/toolchain.ts
scripts.stage:thistle: git submodule update --init deps/teto && git -C deps/teto submodule update --init thistle && bun scripts/ci/stage-thistle-native.mts
scripts.build:thistle:staged: bun run clean && bun run guards:staged && bun run check:scripts && bun --bun tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun src/tool/post.ts
scripts.teto:build:staged: bun run teto:validate && mkdir -p dist/teto && cp deps/teto/dist/teto/* dist/teto/ && bun src/tool/teto-web.ts
scripts.guards: bun run stage:thistle && bun run guards:staged
